title: The relief column

branches.condition: Relief is delivered and Spear makes a Raid
branches.consequence: The relief traffic brings the Sorenne patrol within reach. A force able to sustain combat fights, strengthening its conditioning but further disrupting civilian life. A force too weakened to fight is disabled instead. Grey Petrel Relief also draws the patrol.

branches.condition: Relief is not delivered and Spear makes a Raid
branches.consequence: The patrol is not found. The expedition disrupts civilian traffic without achieving combat. Shared passage, Military passage and private Trade do not draw this patrol.
Relief alone does not cause an attack. The army must actually launch a Raid for these Raid consequences to occur.

guidance: Consider the Navigation order and whether Spear will raid. Council orders remain open after assignments lock, but an independent Raid cannot then be cancelled by a council.
